properties.description: This pipeline is about fetching secret values from key vault. To do that first we need to assign Key Vault Secret User role to ADF as a managed identity. Then use a Web activity and use the Secret URI from key vault secret. This should be followed by a static value of '?api-version=x.x' as provided in the microsoft document. Since it is about fetching a value so the method should be get. Resource field of Web Activity should be filled with a value that is provided in the microsoft document. Here is the link - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/data-factory/how-to-use-azure-key-vault-secrets-pipeline-activities
